summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FeGrro foreman (brygadzista) flow. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified: foreman registration, admin Brygadzisci tab, site assignment, foreman dashboard with hours table, cell editing for today/yesterday, and request modal for past dates.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/worker/register - new foreman registration works
Backend: POST /api/auth/worker/register - same name returns existing user (no duplicates)
Backend: POST /api/auth/worker/register - returns valid JWT token (365-day expiry)
Backend: GET /api/foremen - admin can list all foremen
Backend: New foremen have 'pending' status
Backend: POST /api/foremen/{id}/sites - admin can assign sites to foreman
Backend: POST /api/hours - foreman can edit today's hours
Backend: POST /api/hours - foreman can edit yesterday's hours
Backend: POST /api/hours - foreman blocked from editing past dates (returns 400)
Backend: POST /api/hours - foreman blocked from editing future dates
Backend: POST /api/requests - foreman can create hour request
Backend: GET /api/requests - admin can see foreman requests
Backend: GET /api/foreman/me - returns foreman profile with assigned_sites
Backend: Foreman can access /api/employees, /api/sites, /api/assignments, /api/hours
Frontend: /worker-entry shows first name and last name fields
Frontend: Foreman registration redirects to /worker/dashboard
Frontend: New foreman with no sites sees 'Oczekiwanie na przypisanie' message
Frontend: Admin dashboard has 'Brygadzisci' tab with count badge
Frontend: Pending foremen show 'NOWY' badge
Frontend: Active foremen show 'Aktywny' badge
Frontend: Site toggle buttons visible for each foreman
Frontend: 'Zapisz przypisanie' button present for each foreman
Frontend: Admin 'Prosby' tab shows foreman requests with approve/reject buttons
Frontend: Foreman dashboard shows hours table filtered to assigned sites
Frontend: Foreman sees only employees assigned to their sites
Frontend: 'Mozesz edytowac: Dzisiaj | Wczoraj' info bar displayed
Frontend: Clicking today's cell opens input field for editing
Frontend: Entering hours and pressing Enter saves successfully (toast 'Godziny zapisane')
Frontend: Clicking past date cell opens request modal
Frontend: Request modal has date, hours input, reason input, and send button
Frontend: Dark theme (#1E293B backgrounds) applied correctly
Frontend: Weekend columns have distinct reddish-brown background
context_for_next_testing_agent: All foreman flow features implemented and working: 1) Registration at /worker-entry with first+last name only, returns JWT token stored in localStorage. 2) Admin can see foremen in 'Brygadzisci' tab with NOWY/Aktywny badges. 3) Admin can assign sites by clicking site buttons and 'Zapisz przypisanie'. 4) Foreman dashboard shows hours table filtered to assigned sites only. 5) Foreman can edit cells for today/yesterday (input opens on click). 6) Clicking past date cells opens request modal. 7) Requests appear in admin 'Prosby' tab. Test data: Marek Brygadzista has SASINO assigned, Jan Kowalski is employee with hours in SASINO.
